_doc: Per-item playback overrides, keyed by media.csv filename. start: seconds into a standalone video to begin. trimStart/trimEnd: seconds trimmed from a Live Photo or GIF clip. Defaults are 0; change only after the owner's review, then re-run build. Copy this file to overrides.json next to it and fill in items.

YYYY-MM-DD_EXAMPLE.MOV._why: explain in one line why this clip starts here, so the next person does not undo it
